en: Black‑and‑white view of a European cobblestone square or broad street lined with tall leafy trees. On the right stands a block of ornate, neoclassical multi‑story buildings with rectangular windows and a clock on the roofline; in front of them are lampposts with curved tops. To the left, behind the trees, there are more buildings with shopfronts and awnings, and what appears to be a small park or garden fenced off from the street. A fountain spray is barely visible at the far left. People can be seen walking in the distance, and there is a handcart or wagon at the right edge of the image. The scene is framed with a white border like an old photograph or postcard.
